# KADD Reference

The authoritative architectural intent is maintained in `canonical/kadd/`.
Use the layered KADD set rather than reconstructing architecture from source files.

## Relevant Layers

- `1-definitions/` - Vision, concepts, principles, doctrines
- `2-architecture/` - Systems, subsystems, relationships, decisions
- `3-planning/` - Requirements, risks, roadmap
- `4-implementation/` - Interfaces, data model, storage, configuration, development
- `5-post-implementation/` - Research, lessons, retrospectives
- `9-reference/` - Glossary, appendices, references

## Agent Rules

- Read the relevant KADD layers before architectural recommendations.
- Preserve the three mandatory ecosystem layers: Core, SDK, and Corp.
- Do not change canonical KAD files directly from implementation tasks.
- Changes to architectural intent require the KADD proposal workflow.
- KADD operational reports do not supersede canonical KAD content.
